description: Show the account behind your API key: email, plan, credit balance, today's usage and spend limits. Needs an API key (Authorization: Bearer dc_live_... or X-API-Key).
name: account_status

key_prefix.description: The first characters of the API key in use (never the whole key).

plan.description: The monthly plan, or null when the account has only prepaid credits.

plan_usage.description: Leads used today against the plan's daily allowance (plan customers only).

spend_limit_daily_usd.description: This key's daily spend limit, or null for none.

title: Account status
